_help: The 12 surface sites of Akmentar (Act 4). Format: scripts/sites/site_spot.gd; the draft block: scripts/boards/site_draft.gd.

anubis.name: Statue of Anubis
anubis.desc: Symbols of death and guardianship, and of something sealed below

clue.title: The jackal guards a door
clue.text: The jackal's left paw rests on a carved slab, not on the plinth. Press where the paw points and the stone gives: the guardian is pointing at the way in, not standing in front of it.

horus.name: Statue of Horus
horus.desc: Damaged inscriptions of a struggle over royal authority

clue.title: Two names on one throne
clue.text: Two kings share one throne in the carving. One name was cut out so deeply the chisel broke through the stone. Whoever ruled here was not meant to be remembered as king.

ra.name: Statue of Ra
ra.desc: A solar inscription about the purpose of the place

clue.title: The sun must not reach him
clue.text: The sun disc is carved upside down, setting into the ground. The text beneath it asks that the light never touch the one below, 'lest he remember himself'.

scarabs.name: Wall of Glimmering Scarabs
scarabs.desc: Green stone scarabs with markings hidden among them

clue.title: One scarab faces the wrong way
clue.text: Of the two hundred scarabs, one faces east instead of west. Its underside is worn smooth by hands that pressed it, again and again.

hieroglyphs.name: Wall of Hieroglyphs
hieroglyphs.desc: A historical account, partly damaged or deliberately altered

clue.title: History rewritten
clue.text: The account was re-carved over an older one. Where the new plaster has fallen away, the old text speaks of a priest-king who 'did not stay dead'.

greetings.name: Hall of Greetings
greetings.desc: Ceremonial images of important visitors arriving

clue.title: Guests who carry jars
clue.text: Every visitor in the procession carries a sealed jar, and none carries a gift. The jars are being brought in, not offered.

mummification.name: Hall of Mummification
mummification.desc: Unusual preparations for one particular person

clue.title: Buried alive
clue.text: The embalming scenes skip the first rite entirely. The figure on the table still has open eyes.

souls.name: Hall of Souls
souls.desc: The body, the soul and the afterlife, kept apart

clue.title: The soul kept elsewhere
clue.text: The ba-bird is shown locked in a box, carried far from the body. Here the soul was separated on purpose, so that the body could not rest and the soul could not return.

obelisk.name: The Broken Obelisk
obelisk.desc: Royal names and dates that disagree with history

clue.title: A reign that never ended
clue.text: The king's years are counted to forty, then the count simply stops. There is no death date, only a line of guardians' names that goes on to the bottom of the stone.

offering.name: The Offering Court
offering.desc: Ceremonies with a purpose beyond worship

clue.title: Offerings to keep him away
clue.text: The offerings face away from the temple, as if laid outside a door to keep something in, not to welcome it.

storeroom.name: The Sealed Storeroom
storeroom.desc: Objects hidden during the site's last days

clue.title: Left in a hurry
clue.text: Tools, lamps and half-wrapped linen lie where they were dropped. Someone sealed this room from the inside, and there is no other way out.

clue.title: A star that returns
clue.text: One star is marked with a warning sign and a count of years. By the count, it rises over Akmentar again this very season.
